description:
Post a finished run's assets to the workspace's CONNECTED SOCIAL
ACCOUNT. This is live, public distribution on the customer's channel
— always confirm with the user before calling. Only works if the
grant was authorised with posting allowed. Pass `caption` to own the
words; it goes out verbatim. The call queues the post behind a short
publish window (about two minutes, cancellable) rather than firing
inline: poll get_run after that and read `posts[].url` for the live
permalink and the caption that went out.

caption.description: Optional caption for this publish; goes out verbatim. Omit and Siren writes it.

platform.description: Connected channel to post to: x, instagram, tiktok, linkedin, or youtube.

run_id.description: The run id returned by create_campaign, render_asset, or list_runs.

name: post_run
